title: ShadowFPT: Backdooring Federated Prompt Tuning via Shadow Triggers
abstract: arXiv:2610.22871v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated Prompt Tuning (FPT) adapts large vision--language models by freezing the pretrained backbone and optimizing only lightweight prompt parameters across clients. Although this design improves communication and parameter efficiency, it creates an overlooked security risk. Since the backbone is shared and frozen, a malicious client can induce backdoor behavior through the representation space while keeping its uploaded prompt updates close to benign ones. We propose \textbf{ShadowFPT}, a targeted backdoor attack that exploits this frozen-backbone attack surface. ShadowFPT first pretrains a learnable \emph{Shadow Trigger} against the frozen CLIP visual encoder, using either auxiliary public data or the malicious client's local data, so that triggered inputs are steered toward the target class in representation space. translated_title: ShadowFPT：通过影子触发器对联邦提示调优实施后门攻击
translated_abstract: 联邦提示调优通过冻结预训练骨干网络、仅在客户端间优化轻量级提示参数的方式，来适配大型视觉-语言模型。尽管这种设计提升了通信效率和参数效率，却也带来了一种被忽视的安全风险。由于骨干网络是共享且冻结的，恶意客户端可以在保持其上传的提示更新接近良性更新的同时，通过表示空间诱导后门行为。我们提出了ShadowFPT，一种利用这种冻结骨干网络攻击面的针对性后门攻击。ShadowFPT首先针对冻结的CLIP视觉编码器预训练一个可学习的“影子触发器”，该过程可以使用辅助公开数据或恶意客户端的本地数据，使被触发的输入在表示空间中被引导至目标类别。在联邦提示调优过程中，恶意客户端在当前全局提示下调整该触发器，然后进行优化……
tldr: 提出ShadowFPT后门攻击，利用联邦提示调优中冻结共享骨干网络的攻击面，通过预训练影子触发器在表示空间中将恶意输入引导至目标类别，从而在保持提示更新看似良性的情况下实现隐蔽后门攻击。
